queries.name: event_people
queries.sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, 'people' AS series, count(DISTINCT canonical_id) AS value, 'people' AS unit, count(*) AS sample_size, 'complete' AS state, '' AS reason FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-09-03T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

queries.name: connector_revenue
queries.sql: WITH event_people AS (SELECT canonical_id AS user_id FROM events WHERE event_name = 'signed_up' GROUP BY 1), payment_facts AS (SELECT json_extract_string(data, '$.user_id') AS user_id, try_cast(json_extract_string(data, '$.amount') AS BIGINT) AS amount, try_cast(json_extract_string(data, '$.occurred_at') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS occurred_at FROM external_rows WHERE connector_id = '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333' AND table_name = 'payments'), payments_by_user_day AS (SELECT user_id, CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) AS payment_date, sum(amount) AS amount FROM payment_facts WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT strftime(payment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, 'revenue' AS series, sum(amount) AS value, 'usd_cents' AS unit, count(*) AS sample_size, 'complete' AS state, '' AS reason FROM event_people e JOIN payments_by_user_day p ON p.user_id = e.user_id GROUP BY payment_date ORDER BY payment_date

queries.name: cohort
queries.sql: WITH people AS (SELECT canonical_id AS user_id, min(CASE WHEN event_name = 'signed_up' THEN CAST(timestamp AS DATE) END) AS cohort_date, min(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchased' THEN CAST(timestamp AS DATE) END) AS converted_date FROM events GROUP BY 1) SELECT strftime(cohort_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, 'conversion' AS series, CASE WHEN converted_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value, 'people' AS unit, 1 AS sample_size, 'complete' AS state, '' AS reason, strftime(cohort_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS cohort_date, date_diff('day', cohort_date, converted_date) AS age_days, true AS eligible, converted_date IS NOT NULL AS converted FROM people ORDER BY user_id
